map.载鱼量按增氧功率估算（精养每 kW 约支撑 700 kg/亩产量，半精养 450: The carrying capacity is estimated from the aeration power (intensive supports about 700 kg/mu of yield per kW, semi-intensive 450 and extensive 200); a safety ceiling is also set by the water volume (intensive ≤60 kg/m³ of standing biomass). The recommended density takes the smaller of the two, and density = carrying capacity ÷ (size × survival rate).

map.5 亩、水深 1.2 m、增氧 4 kW、半精养、目标 15 g、成活率 75%: 5 mu, 1.2 m deep, 4 kW aeration, semi-intensive, target 15 g, survival rate 75%
map.默认参数：功率载鱼量 = (4/5)×450 = 360 kg/亩；水体载鱼量: With the default parameters: the power-based carrying capacity = (4/5)×450 = 360 kg/mu; the volume-based carrying capacity = 3×(5×1.2×666.67)/5 = 2400 kg/mu; take the smaller 360 kg/mu; stocking density = 360/(15/100)/0.75 ≈ 3200 shrimp/mu, a total stocking of ≈ 16000, with an expected yield of 1800 kg; aeration of 0.8 kW/mu reaches the low-risk line.
map.为什么取『功率』和『水体』两个上限的较小值？: Why take the smaller of the power and volume ceilings?
map.两者任一成为瓶颈都会限制产量，取小值保证不突破任一约束，是保守安全的设计。: Either one becoming a bottleneck limits production; taking the smaller value ensures neither constraint is breached, a conservative and safe choice.
map.增氧功率不足会怎样？: What happens if the aeration power is insufficient?
map.功率载鱼量下降，若低于 0.5 kW/亩风险升高，应降低密度或加增氧机。: The power-based carrying capacity falls; below 0.5 kW/mu the risk rises, so reduce the density or add aerators.
